text:
پانی مٹھا کس رتی؟
جو پکن جس رتی۔
romanized:
Pani mittha kis rutti?
Jau pakkin jis rutti.
literal_en: In what season is water sweet? In the season in which barley ripens,

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
